notes.title: Demo 1.3 Patch Note!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44197286/edc758ebe0761dba7ca6188112c2b1c6f10fc852.png[/img]
Hello, everyone!

This time, we focused on fixing bugs and improving overall quality of life! Some of you may have noticed new features and feedback changes—those are part of this patch!

[h3][b]Fixes:[/b][/h3]

[list]
[*] Resolved issue causing duplicate cards to disappear when reshuffling the draw pile
[*] Adjusted collision settings for better accuracy (we will continue to improve this)
[*] Fixed a fatal error that occurred when loading section 2
[*] General optimizations to address various issues
[/list]

[h3]Changes:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Enhanced card play (you no longer need to release the button to play cards)
[*] Improved instructions
[*] Clearer display on monitors
[*] Enhanced UI feedback
[*] Return to arcade now set you at month 1, keeping your previous cards so you can keep playing with them!
[/list]

And as we've reminded you before:

DON'T VENTURE OUTSIDE THE ARCADE FOR YOUR OWN SAFETY

Human and Power are not responsible for any mishaps that may occur outside the demo.

With that said, see you soon!

notes.title: Demo 1.22 Patch Note!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44197286/edc758ebe0761dba7ca6188112c2b1c6f10fc852.png[/img]
Hello, everyone!

We’ve brought some new changes to improve the game's balance and progression, along with a few bug fixes based on the issues you made us aware of, and we've addressed them!

[h3][b]Fixes:[/b][/h3]

[list]
[*] After paying its cost, the package trader will no longer trap you with it.
[*] Something made the card Sparks (Static) useless, this will no longer happen.
[*] Polar Exchange has its text corrected to "effects every 5 seconds" (it was mistakenly described as 10 seconds before). 
[/list]
[h3]Changes:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Plague Spoils now grant +1 life in addition to the effect of generating a battery when destroying Stars!
[*] There is a higher chance of finding the package trader in the second month.
[*] Prices of packages and Cards on sale have been adjusted!
[*] You can now cancel package openings.
[/list]


[h3][b]New Addition:[/b][/h3]

[h3]Cyber Green![/h3]
Foil Card
Effect:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44197286/0c902795ba3a6af438e2c26f0c64007906c7e28f.png[/img]
+1 life, increases battery earnings by +5.

[h3]Exemplar Worker[/h3]
Foil Card
Effect:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44197286/826dde21f415fb1159de206a1c37f4503d101080.png[/img]
+1 life, increases the total time by +5 seconds.


We have an exciting announcement to make in the next few days, so keep an eye on us and wait for more updates and content while you play MONOTONIA DEMO!

See you!

notes.title: NEW DEMO AVAILABLE
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44197286/edc758ebe0761dba7ca6188112c2b1c6f10fc852.png[/img]

It is with great enthusiasm that we present the demo of "Monotonia", an independent Brazilian game that highlights horror with roguelite deck-building and platformer gameplay, constantly challenging expectations at every turn. Although its initial aesthetic may suggest a charming game, don't be fooled. Behind this adorable façade lies an experience that will take you on an unsettling journey full of mysteries to [strike]lose[/strike] improve yourself!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44197286/1863cd6ba123ebd649adbf174f8e95877cebe03c.gif[/img]

[i][h3][h2][h1][b]The demo is a standalone experience that will not be included in the final game, offering a unique immersion into the universe of Monotonia.[/b][/h1][/h2][/h3][/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44197286/62929c5a3c7f6e6002ea5249c44ec4507be72b8f.png[/img]


[b][h1]More than meets the eye[/h1][/b]

The Monotonia demo is a complete and free experience, just like the prologue *Monotonia: First Contact*, which is available on Steam. During the demo, you can aim for the highest score—a challenge shared by other players, where it's possible to check the results and strive for the top spot on the online leaderboard.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44197286/39a6182e8a2a0da682661a40305435b02fb1b050.png[/img]

At first glance, the game has friendly graphics, but as you dive deeper into the narrative, you are confronted with challenges that require skill and a sharp mind to unravel [strike]dark enigmas and secrets[/strike] the road to success.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44197286/ff34b27b9162d87e993d16bd4a64eb5da655dc67.png[/img]

Work, pay the bills, and survive. How far will you be able to go?
Check MONOTONIA Steam Page
